# defectdojo_notifications (Data Source)

Data source for DefectDojo Notifications: per-channel notification preferences for a scope (global default, per-user, or per-product). Looked up by id only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_notifications" "example" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier

### Read-Only

- `auto_close_engagement` (Set of String) Notification channels for when an engagement is auto-closed.
- `close_engagement` (Set of String) Notification channels for when an engagement is closed.
- `code_review` (Set of String) Notification channels for when a code review is requested.
- `engagement_added` (Set of String) Notification channels for when an engagement is added.
- `jira_update` (Set of String) Notification channels for when a JIRA issue is updated.
- `other` (Set of String) Notification channels for other events.
- `product` (Number) The ID of the Product this notification preference row is scoped to.
- `product_added` (Set of String) Notification channels for when a product is added.
- `product_type_added` (Set of String) Notification channels for when a product type is added.
- `review_requested` (Set of String) Notification channels for when a review is requested.
- `risk_acceptance_expiration` (Set of String) Notification channels for when a risk acceptance is about to expire.
- `scan_added` (Set of String) Notification channels for when a scan is added/imported.
- `scan_added_empty` (String) Triggered whenever an (re-)import has been done (even if that created/updated/closed no findings).
- `sla_breach` (Set of String) Notification channels for when an SLA is breached.
- `sla_breach_combined` (Set of String) Notification channels for combined SLA breach notifications.
- `stale_engagement` (Set of String) Notification channels for stale engagements.
- `template` (Boolean) Whether this row is the notification template applied to new users/products.
- `test_added` (Set of String) Notification channels for when a test is added.
- `upcoming_engagement` (Set of String) Notification channels for upcoming engagements.
- `user` (Number) The ID of the User this notification preference row is scoped to.
- `user_mentioned` (Set of String) Notification channels for when a user is mentioned.
